- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_evidence.py | location=_clip_bytes tail-decode at the branch handling the truncated tail
  PROBLEM: The tail-clipping branch decodes with tail.decode("utf-8") while the head-clipping branch uses data[:room].decode("utf-8", errors="ignore").
  WHY: If the raw log data contains non-UTF-8 bytes, the tail path raises UnicodeDecodeError while the head path survives silently. Suggested minimal fix: Change tail.decode("utf-8") to tail.decode("utf-8", errors="ignore") for defensive parity. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
- changelog.d/6215-heal-evidence-run-provenance.md:Lines 1-2 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The PR adds a second changelog fragment beyond the principal changelog.d/6055-heal-evidence-bundle.md.
  WHY: CLAUDE.md section 20.B says "One fragment per PR. Never reuse another PR's filename -- the unique path is the whole point." Section 20.A lists what requires one fragment per PR, not one fragment per topic. scripts/assemble_changelog.py will process both fragments at release time, creating two separate entries in CHANGELOG.md from the same PR.
